rows.indian_statistical_institute_isi_kolkata: Ph.D. in Computer Science / Mathematics or related subjects

content_sections.heading: ISI Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. No.PU/507/ADV/897 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download ISI notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Ph.D. in Computer Science / Mathematics or related subjects (submitted / awarded), with a strong background in theoretical computer science research as evident from publications in top CS conferences/journals. Experience: Strong background in theoretical computer science research as evident from publications in top CS conferences/journals. Age limit: Maximum 45 years (as on 29 October 2026) Age relaxation: SC/ST/OBC/Women/Differently abled As per Government of India norms Other conditions: No TA/DA will be paid Mere fulfilling essential qualification does not guarantee selection Institute reserves the right not to appoint Desirable: Research experience in theoretical CS in top institutes/universities.

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for ISI Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates with incomplete resumes will be summarily rejected.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Depending on qualification and experience of the selected candidate and as per rules of the Institute. Appointment is initially up to at most 31 March 2027 from the date of joining, which may be extended later / terminated earlier based on performance and availability of the required funds.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

rows.event: Email submission of resume and documents

content_sections.heading: How Will ISI Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting based on qualifications and experience Written/Programming test if required Walk-in Interview Written/Programming test may be conducted for shortlisting the candidates for the interview.

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Signed application with Subject 'Application for PLP position for A.C.M.U. Project' Biodata (in English) with Name, Mailing Address, E-mail Address, Telephone/Mobile No., Parent's/Spouse's Name, Date of birth, Aadhaar Card/Voter Card/ PAN Card Academic Qualifications (mentioning percentage of marks obtained starting from 10th board examination onwards) Experience certificate (if any) SC/ST/OBC/Differently abled status Certificate (if applicable) One passport size photograph (self-attested on reverse side) Self-attested copies of all documents/testimonials

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ISI Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Fill in the form and attach the documents listed above. Send it to Advanced Computing & Microelectronics Unit, 5th Floor, Platinum Jubilee Academic Building of Indian Statistical Institute, 203 B. T. Road, Kolkata- 700 108, by email. Apply on or before 27 October 2026.
